concerns.text: US-2 Scenario 1 requires chirp-mass bias < 10% for ANY quantized waveform with SNR > 10, but T005's verification checks bias only 'on high-SNR 16-bit signals' — silently excluding the low-bit-depth cases that are the research question. Weakened acceptance criterion.

T007's fallback ('if the reduced batch cannot achieve this, report the achieved std and its limitation honestly') converts SC-005's pass/fail criterion (std < 0.5 SNR units) into a best-effort report with no spec-level amendment authorizing the relaxation.

SC-003 and US-2 Scenario 3 require MEASURED total inference runtime ≤ 6 h on 2 cores; T003 records only generation runtime plus a 'projected total pipeline runtime'. No task measures actual end-to-end inference runtime against the 6-hour bound — the criterion is verified by projection, not measurement.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Scope note / T003 vs spec.md:US-1 Scenario 3
concerns.text: US-1 Scenario 3's acceptance condition is a 10,000-signal batch within 7 GB; tasks deliver only the N=1200 pilot with the full study deferred. The plan stages this, but spec.md was never updated, so the scenario's acceptance condition is unevaluable in this iteration — retroactive narrowing without a spec amendment.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Scope note & T001/T002 vs constitution.md:Principle VI
concerns.text: Constitution VI enumerates allowed bit depths as exactly '8, 10, 12, 14, or 16 bits'; tasks T001/T002 implement and test 1-bit quantization per FR-002. Tasks cannot resolve this spec-vs-constitution conflict; it needs a documented constitution amendment or spec change before the 1-bit tasks are executable as constitution-compliant.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Scope note & Corrections section vs constitution.md:Principle III/V
concerns.text: Constitution III/V require datasets checksummed with hashes recorded (state yaml artifact_hashes / 'recorded under data/'); tasks.md forbids research scripts from writing any hashes and assigns nothing that records checksums under data/. The platform-derives-hashes claim is not reflected in the constitution — either the constitution must be amended or a task must record checksums under data/ as written.
